summary: Monroe County, PA steel fire tower of 1921, 60 feet tall, no longer standing; the register gives no coordinates and no source describes what remains today.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower, about 60 feet tall
facts.status_note: No longer standing, per the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register; no source describes what remains at the site today.
facts.agency: Pennsylvania Department of Forests and Waters

events.note: Register gives 1921; an August 1921 item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page describes it as one of three steel towers being erected in the district
Towerman Francis Kern, his wife and daughter lived in the cabin at the base (October 1934 newspaper item)

corrections.proposed: Pennsylvania Department of Forests and Waters
corrections.why: The record's agency field holds a date line from a 1921 item. The 1934 newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page names the Pennsylvania Department of Forests and Waters as the agency of the tower.

notes_for_editor: Location is not established: the register gives no coordinates, and the record point is an approximate GNIS gap match. A Mount Minsi lookout page (https://willhiteweb.com/appalachian_trail/fire_lookouts/mount_minsi/del_water_forest_046.htm) describes a 1921 steel tower of 47 feet on Mount Minsi with footings still on the summit. Its height differs from this record's 60 feet, so it is probably a different tower. It is not used in the story; please check whether the two are the same. Removal date and any description of the site today were not found. Record agency 'August 1921:' is a parse error; the proposed correction is in corrections. The 1934 article quotes 'Forest Leaves' indirectly through the Forest Lookouts page and was not read at source.
